board.note: 61-cell regular hexagon, radius 5 (side length 5). Rows 0-8 with widths 5-6-7-8-9-8-7-6-5. Hex adjacency: 6 neighbors per interior cell.

captured.note: Opponent marbles pushed off the board. First to capture 6 wins.

marble.note: Each player has 14 marbles. Move 1-3 inline marbles one step in any hex direction. A line of N marbles can push a shorter opponent line (sumito): 3v2, 3v1, 2v1. Pushed-off marbles are captured.

inline_move.definition: Move 1, 2, or 3 marbles in a line one step along the line direction. All marbles in the group must belong to the current player and be contiguous.
constraints: all marbles in group are contiguous along direction
all marbles belong to current player

broadside_move.definition: Move 2 or 3 marbles in a line one step perpendicular to the line direction. No pushing allowed on broadside moves.
constraints: all destination cells must be empty
direction is perpendicular to the line axis

sumito.definition: An inline move that pushes opponent marbles. The pushing group must outnumber the pushed group: 3v2, 3v1, or 2v1.
constraints: pushed group contains only opponent marbles
no friendly marble behind the pushed group (unless edge)

capture.definition: A marble pushed beyond the board edge is captured and moved to the opponent's captured zone.
capture.effect: move marble to opponent captured zone
